title: Origin story: Kaelith
description: Kaelith was a mortal gatekeeper of the city of Venn who swore on the First Seal to hold the night gate through a siege of shadow-wights. She held it for forty-one nights without sleep, and when the seal's magic faded, her oath did not — it remade her into the Warden, an immortal bound to every promise ever sworn in her hearing.

title: Ability profile: Kaelith
description: Ranked abilities: Oath-keeping — rank 100/100; Endurance — rank 97/100; Vigilance — rank 96/100; Threshold magic — rank 95/100; Judgment — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Kaelith
description: Powers: Any oath sworn in her hearing becomes binding; Thresholds obey her — no door bars her; She cannot break a promise, and neither can those she binds.

title: Stamina feats: Kaelith
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Stood forty-one nights without rest; Carries ten thousand oaths without faltering.

title: Crossover notes: Kaelith
description: Kaelith crosses naturally with: oaths, thresholds, unbreakable promises.

title: Design notes: Kaelith
description: The Signature oath-canon; a promise made is a law of nature.
